# CANDIDATE: END_OF_DAY_RIBBON_CONVERGENCE_MEANREVERT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Near the close, ribbon convergence (EMA8-EMA55 tight) and price near VWAP indicate intraday exhaustion, prompting a mean-reversion trade opposite the intraday bias. This captures edge by fading extended moves when momentum has dissipated but price remains extended from fair value (VWAP).

## Mechanism

Between 15:00-15:55 EST, if (EMA8 − EMA55) / price < 0.001 (ribbon tight) AND |price − VWAP| / price < 0.002 (price near VWAP) THEN:
- If price > VWAP AND EMA8 > EMA21 > EMA55 (bullish ribbon alignment) enter short at close
- Else if price < VWAP AND EMA8 < EMA21 < EMA55 (bearish ribbon alignment) enter long at close
Exit: stop at 0.5% beyond entry on the opposite side of VWAP, TP1 at 0.75R (quick scalp), no runner. Additional filters: VIX < 25, avoid last 30 minutes if major scheduled news (FOMC, CPI, NFP, mega-cap earnings).

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+ account; $1K paper ~= 14% headline P&L (per risk-rules.md position sizing).
2. **Sample bias:** Proposed trigger has zero historical validation; sample size = 0; high overfit risk until Stage-1 backtest confirms robustness across regimes.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (no walk-forward held-out window tested).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (no realistic simulator validation on top 3 J days).
5. **Failure modes:** 
   - Worst day: whipsaw during high-volume news events (e.g., FOMC) triggering false mean-reversion signals.
   - Max drawdown: consecutive losing days if intraday bias persists into close (trending market exhaustion fails).
   - Blow-up scenario: volatility expansion causing ribbon to remain wide while price deviates far from VWAP, leading to repeated counter-trend entries against strong momentum.
6. **Concentration:** unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest (cannot estimate top-5 days contribution without P&L distribution).
